random_model: Independent additive Gaussian error, fixed per design/site; nominal zero stays off; effective brightness clipped to [0,1]. Same noise draws in both random cases.
scope: Image sites only; barcode and fiducial signals excluded by the image renderer. No synthesis or picklist changes.

render_settings.alignment_center_default: center of full C12–C1 / H01–H15 staple grid, including middle column gap
render_settings.alignment_center_frame: unshifted image-site coordinates; C6 H01 is (0,0)
render_settings.alignment_distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian dx, dy, angle; shared rigid transform within each origami
render_settings.alignment_error_frame: origami-aligned axes, before decoded shift and display rotation
render_settings.edge_handling: Gaussian tails outside the field are cropped without renormalization
render_settings.finite_count_scope: alignment uncertainty only; fractional site intensities, no occupancy or photon noise
render_settings.normalization: mean per design; normalization balances unequal quadrant sampling and fixes total design weight; shared exposure, no image-dependent scaling
